description: pixel art landscape, the deepest hellish level of an ancient labyrinth of the System: cracked walls of black stone glowing from within with red-hot seams, corridors branching into darkness, burning red runes along the walls, embers and ash in the air, a faint glow of lava under the floor, menacing and deadly, wide panorama for a dim background behind text, low contrast, muted dark palette of black, deep red and charcoal with orange and crimson accents, no text, no border, no people
